OSF_OPENBAO_ADDR.description: OpenBao's address, for example http://127.0.0.1:8200. Required by every command but policy.

OSF_OPENBAO_TOKEN.description: An OpenBao token with the policy that policy write prints, the console's; or with the one of policy read, which only reads. Required by every command but policy.

OSF_OPENBAO_MOUNT.description: The factory's KV version 2 mount: one mount per factory, the same as the egress proxy's.
